entries.result: Booklet stanza has paired rhyme. Satirical ten-line stanza rewritten to remove the invented face insult and invented beer; all source propositions retained. Its end-rhyme is not reproduced throughout; that is a literary translation tradeoff, not omitted narrative.
Sound-fragment and word-split retained; unmotivated hin removed; missing-a rebus adapted with kat/matros. Reviewed against original.

Every tree guest and saint/processional object checked against source. No omissions found. Distinguished incense-censer bearers from incense-container bearers. Names and intentionally absurd catalogue retained.

French letters has contraceptive slang and literary-register ambiguity. franske gummibreve now hints both word/letter and condom without an explanatory insertion. Danish literary acceptability remains a native choice.

Inkle is a woven narrow tape/band. Literal negerbånd retains the historical racial term; precise medical joke remains uncertain. Joyce notebook has only inkle, no diagnostic gloss. No unsupported medical expansion made.

Masonic grammar repaired; complete pursuit list modernised; reversed Danish prayer and reversed Gud retained. Dog/God cannot simultaneously remain an exact Danish character reversal and mean dog: disclosed formal loss, no spurious dialogue added.
Broken macaronic French and incomplete body phrase preserved deliberately, not silently corrected. Published German song crux preserved; Danish gloss grammatical subject repaired.

Six-line doggerel and five-line POLDY acrostic complete. Blood-libel song checked line by line; speaker context and every event retained, no sanitising historical antisemitism. Ballad stanza sizes preserved; complete rhyme/melody matching is not claimed.

Smell/melon blend strengthened with duftgule. All fifteen Sindbad chain members retained; Danish occupational compounds replace recognisable meanings, opaque final terms kept as sound play. No invented meanings to manufacture full rhyme.

Brow/part-brownpart ambiguity translated semantically but full English sound pun not recoverable with same anatomy. Cottage cake kept as enkel kage: not misidentified as bread or a slice. Nothing kills me idiom remains an uncertain clothing-context reading (ingenting klæder mig helt ordentligt), needing a specialist preference, not treated as verified.

Hotchpotch mistranslated as minced-beef dish repaired to pærevælling; deliberately distorted heass sounds kept. Briggs giver brig (meaningless Danish) changed to Briggs der rapser, following slang annotation; this restores sense but not exact sound pun. Buttons and bloomers name/body ambiguities retained.

Non-compo conservatively rendered without substitute materials. Historical advertisement origin corroborated but exact product construction not verified. No assertion of particular leather composition.
Opaque untranslated moneypennyknapper replaced with childlike pengemøntknapper. Notebook source money buttons supports money/button blend, not modern brand association.

Carriagesack confirmed verbatim in Joyce notebook; does not establish whether sack-carriage transposition or actual bag. Literal vognsæk retained rather than silently changing to sack truck. Genuine referential uncertainty.
Historical nautical curricle resolved as coracle-type light skin boat. End-over-end churn repaired to butter churn with rotating barrel, not merely rocking churn.

Heave offering changed from løfteoffer (normally votive offering in Danish) to explicit offergave løftet op. Retains raising action and sacrifice rather than incorrect promise/vow. Source childbirth strain pun only partial in Danish.
Budget retained as publication label instead of generic avisen; exact periodical identification unasserted. Loglady kept as descriptive idle pyntedukke; night cycling corrected earlier.

Independent 1922 witness has single question after budget. Removed duplicate question tail from446 in both candidate languages, retained447. Restored English account line breaks. Original source untouched.

Corrected prior review error: Molly is33 on Bloomsday from explicit8September1870 date at17/636, despite her claim inPenelope that she will turn33. Character claim unchanged. Rudy death9January1894 was just over10years before16June1904, not11years. Both guides corrected; explicit dates outrank narrator age claim.
